# Cache key for the analysis job's pip download, and nothing else.
#
# setup-python keys its cache on the OS, the Python version and a hash of
# cache-dependency-path — not on the job, and not on the extras being installed.
# Point two jobs at the same file and they share a key: the bare `test` job
# installs three small pure-Python wheels, finishes first, saves that as the
# cache, and the analysis job then gets an exact-key hit and never saves its own.
# The job that downloads numpy, scipy, soundfile and pyloudnorm would keep
# downloading them every run.
#
# This file exists so that key changes when the analysis dependency set changes
# and at no other time. Keying on ci.yml instead busted the cache on every
# unrelated CI edit, including edits to this comment's predecessor.
dev,analysis,match
